test_title: PYST 4: SSC CPO - Reasoning (Held on: 11 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two Statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All queens are kings.

Some kings are aces.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some kings are queens.

II. All queens are aces.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow.

solution:
Explanation:

The least possible Venn Diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ed1a0a4baaae21db905ddfe1200f25e2e4b1a347ebd3ce47bbcd039ef7d8d642.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some kings are queens. → Follows (because all queens are kings, so we can say that some kings are definitely queens.)

II. All queens are aces. → Does not follow (because some kings are aces and all queens are kings, hence we cannot definitely say that all queens are definitely aces.) 

Hence, “Only conclusion I follows.”.
